config.goal: Port matmul_backward_bias_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/matmul_backward_bias.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T OC` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 0.005 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so replace or empty those files once your own port is done.
